title: Civic Notice: The Fog
description: A flat, automated Snazzie FM Civic Notification System test. The fog has reached the residential level and is now counting the doors. Calm dystopian instructions, then a sign-off that was never a test.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> Residents in low-lying districts are advised that the fog has reached the second floor.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Do not open a window to confirm this. <p:0.5> The fog is now counting the doors.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If the fog knows your name, this is normal. <p:0.3> Do not answer to it. Pretend you have not seen it.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This concludes the test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> The fog has been with you for some time. You were never warned, because there was never a way out.
